response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(`ANA Pattern`), '') AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(`ANA Pattern`), '')), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS overall_mean FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_igg FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_igg > m.overall_mean) SELECT k.pattern, k.avg_igg, k.avg_igg - m.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean, k.avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k CROSS JOIN m ORDER BY k.avg_igg DESC

assumptions.assumption: Examinations with a NULL, empty or whitespace-only `ANA Pattern` all count as 'no recorded pattern' and form a single group (shown as a NULL pattern).
Groups whose aCL IgG values are all missing have a NULL average. They are excluded from the mean of group averages and cannot be kept.
The distance from the kept patterns' mean is signed (average minus that mean), so it can be negative. Both distances are in aCL IgG units.
